module.purpose: End-to-end coverage for creating, inviting members to, configuring, and disbanding an organization team through the web application.
module.summary: This Playwright test exercises the complete team-management wizard. It provisions an organization administrator, creates a team, optionally completes Stripe billing, invites and removes a member, publishes the invitation flow, configures a round-robin event type, and finally disbands the team. Fixture cleanup and direct database deletion keep test-created users isolated.
module.businessContext: This validates the organization team lifecycle and billing-gated onboarding experience. Failures can block administrators from creating teams, managing membership, or removing teams.

io: Navigates browser pages and interacts with team-management controls.
Creates, authenticates, and deletes test organization and user fixtures.
network: Exercises application navigation, authentication, team creation, invitation, configuration, and disbanding through Playwright.

sectionMap.name: suite setup and cleanup
sectionMap.intent: Defines the Teams suite and removes organizations and users after each test.

sectionMap.name: fixture provisioning
sectionMap.intent: Creates an organization administrator and authenticates the browser session.

sectionMap.name: team creation
sectionMap.intent: Completes the initial team creation wizard and verifies pending membership state.

sectionMap.name: billing branch
sectionMap.intent: Completes Stripe test checkout when team billing is enabled.
branchOutcomes: billing enabled: fill Stripe test checkout

sectionMap.name: member invitation
sectionMap.intent: Invites a new member and verifies two pending members are displayed.

sectionMap.name: member removal
sectionMap.intent: Removes the newest pending member and deletes its directly-created database user.

sectionMap.name: team configuration
sectionMap.intent: Publishes invitations and configures a round-robin event type.

sectionMap.name: team disbanding
sectionMap.intent: Confirms team deletion and verifies the team no longer appears in the listing.

edgeCases.behavior: Skips Stripe checkout and continues directly to team onboarding verification.
Adds the invitee and verifies the pending-member list contains two entries.
Removes the most recently displayed member and verifies only the original member remains.
Verifies the team listing contains zero entries matching the created team name.

errorHandling.action: Playwright assertions or database deletion failures propagate and fail the test.

invariants.description: The browser remains authenticated before navigating to team management.
Team creation leaves exactly one pending member before invitation.
Member invitation increases the pending-member count to two.
Removing the last pending member restores the pending-member count to one.
Disbanding returns to the teams page and removes the created team from the listing.

assumptions.description: The fixture-provided page, users, and orgs objects expose working test-environment operations.
IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED accurately reflects whether the team flow requires Stripe checkout.
The directly-created invitee can be deleted by its email after removal from the pending list.

ambiguities.question: Does the fixture cleanup also remove teams and related records, or is disbanding required for complete isolation?
What application behavior is expected when Stripe checkout is unavailable while billing is enabled?
ambiguities.affects: billing branch and team creation reliability

concurrencyModel.notes: All browser and database operations are awaited sequentially within one test; afterEach cleanup runs after the test.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An administrator creates a team, invites and removes a member, completes team setup, and disbands the team.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the complete team lifecycle, membership management, setup navigation, and final disbanding behavior.
